name: ai-eir
description: AI EIR (Entrepreneur in Residence): a central AI EIR agent interviews you about your business, drives it through the 24 steps of Disciplined Entrepreneurship, assembles a venture-grade business plan reviewed by simulated expert/VC review councils, then executes Paul Cheek's 15 Tactics (Disciplined Entrepreneurship: Startup Tactics) to turn that plan into a real, running business — checking back in with you on a recurring cadence as it grows. Built to run inside a Claude Cowork project with a persistent working folder, not a one-off chat.
